boundary.agent: owns archived conversation eligibility, complete execution graph archive payload, fenced purge, and Agent subject data
boundary.todo: owns todo rows and mutation receipts and returns its own durable subject-erasure receipt
boundary.knowledge: owns attachments, artifacts, libraries, saved copies, physical content, remote deletion recovery, and its durable receipts
boundary.runtime: composes opaque owner handlers and the Agent retention executor through public SDK contracts
boundary.lifecycle: owns policy publication, legal holds, cleanup jobs, archives, subject request workflow, execution steps, and deletion replay registration
